name: Data for: A Low Shot Learning Method for Tea Leaf’s Disease Identification
description: The data contain 120 images of 3 types of tea leaf's diseases, namely tea red scab, tea red leaf spot and tea leaf blight. Part of the tea leaf's disease images are taken in Tianjingshan National Forest Park of China，Its geographical coordinates are 31° 14′ 37′′ north latitude, 117° 36′ 16′′ east longitude, and 40 meters above sea level. The hand-held digital camera for photography is Canon EOS 80D SLR camera, and the unmanned aerial vehicle used for photography is the DJI phantom 4pro, whose flight altitude is 10 meters.Another part of the tea leaf's disease images come from Anhui Provincial Agricultural Committee's pest and disease agricultural graphic database.
